# Jar Suite

Jar Suite is software for lawn care and home service companies, built by Seasonal Lawncare and Mosquito Pros in Western New York. Each Jar does one job. It is not a full office system for scheduling, routing or billing.

Website: https://jarsuite.com/
Access: Request access at https://jarsuite.com/contact/. Accounts for outside companies are opened one at a time. There is no self-serve sign-up.

## Products and prices (US dollars, as of 2026-11-20)

- QuoteJar (https://jarsuite.com/quotejar/) — Lawn care instant quote software. A homeowner enters an address on the company website and gets a lawn quote. The lawn is measured as part of the quote. Spam filter for website leads is included. Lawn only; mosquito and pest quoting is not included yet. $300 per month.
- SalesJar (https://jarsuite.com/salesjar/) — Daily sales dashboard. Daily sales, month to date, year over year, cancels and production, pulled from the office software every day. $399 per month.
- TipJar (https://jarsuite.com/tipjar/) — Review request software. After a visit it asks for a Google or Facebook review and collects a post-service survey, including an NPS-style score. Office scoreboards by technician. $449 per month.
- FriendJar (https://jarsuite.com/tipjar/#friendjar) — Customer referral add-on to TipJar. Personal referral links for customers and technicians. The office confirms matches before a reward is due. $49 per month. Requires TipJar.
- ClickJar (https://jarsuite.com/clickjar/) — Ad reporting dashboard. Spend and leads across ad channels, keyword research, and SEO tracking, including where pages are missing in local results. $99 per month.
- RingJar (https://jarsuite.com/ringjar/) — Call tracking. A tracking number per ad source, forwarded to the office line, with answered and missed calls logged, and callers matched to the customer list when possible. Not GPS and not a full phone system. $49 per month.
- FleetJar (https://jarsuite.com/fleetjar/) — Fleet management for trucks: records, a QR code per truck, checklists, problem reports and repairs, service history, tires, parts and plate expirations. Not live GPS. $9 per truck per month, or $149 per month unlimited.

Pricing: https://jarsuite.com/pricing/
